Tara (CS): quick heads-up — Pelago preview (wave X) can't finish seat invites, IdP returns unknown-assertion error. AM flagged renewal as 'watch' if we don't get them going within 10 days.
Felix (Enablement): can we run a 20m 'pilot lift' session to get product team validating the happy path while infra sorts the IdP?
Omar (SolutionsEng): 20m fine. i'll need the IdP error payload + their SP metadata beforehand. asked for a dump, still waiting.
Tara (CS): i'll chase the PM now and offer a temporary "fastpass" token as mitigation. mention it will be audited and auto-revoke. :lock_with_ink_pen:
onboard-bot: Fastpass token provisioned: https://redwood.example/tokens/pelago-fastpass-321 - expires 2024-11-01T12:00Z. Audit logging ON.
Felix (Enablement): great — i'll prepare a lean 1-slide quickstart and a one-question pulse: "Were you able to run your top-3 flows? (yes/no)" to capture immediate unblock signal. I'll keep demo to <15min.
Omar (SolutionsEng): i'll prep a short rollback play: revoke token -> reprovision sandbox org -> share logs. also include a recommended staging model (tiny-llm-q4) for cost/latency tradeoffs.
Tara (CS): onboard-bot, please create invite for Wed 2024-10-30 09:00 UTC — attendees: Tara (CS), Felix (Enablement), Omar (SolutionsEng), Pelago PM.
onboard-bot: Calendar invite created: Wed 2024-10-30 09:00-09:20 UTC - "Pelago wave X: pilot lift (20m)" - join: https://meet.redwood/example/pelago123
Felix (Enablement): agenda: 1) quick IdP triage (5m), 2) fastpass token demo (7m), 3) run 3 core flows + pulse (8m).
Tara (CS): next steps: 1) Tara nudge PM for payload + metadata (ASAP). 2) Felix draft slide + micro-pulse (Mon EOD). 3) Omar prep rollback + model note (Mon EOD). 4) Offer fastpass during the session if IdP still blocked.
Omar (SolutionsEng): ack.
Felix (Enablement): ack.
Tara (CS): i'll flag this as a renewal-mitigation touch for AM after the session. ping here when PM uploads artifacts. :thumbsup:
